Introduction

Yerin Baek, also known as Baek Yerin, is a South Korean singer and songwriter. First known for appearing in the show "Star King", she was dubbed 'ballad genius'. Following her appearance in the variety show, Yerin became a JYP Entertainment trainee and debuted as a member of the duo 15&.

Following her departure from JYP Entertainment in 2019, Yerin launched her independent label Blue Vinyl and has since released music as a solo artist. She also created the co-ed rock band, The Volunteers, in 2018 and has been actively promoting since the creation of the group.

In April 2024, the members of The Volunteers left their previous label Blue Vinyl and they founded their independent label, peoplelikepeople.
